children: and AVOMO, the autonomous vehicle arm of Moove Cars Group, have received Spain’s first national permit for Level 4 autonomous passenger vehicles to operate on public roads.

, issued by Spain’s Directorate General of Traffic, allows the companies to begin testing WeRide’s GXR autonomous vehicles and mapping roads across the Madrid region ahead of a planned commercial launch.

The initial rollout will involve 20 vehicles, equipped with WeRide’s autonomous-driving technology and supervised by an in-car specialist. The vehicles are expected to operate across high-demand areas of Greater Madrid.
Commercial operations in Spain are expected to begin by the end of 2026 following the completion of deployment preparations and the achievement of the necessary operational and regulatory milestones.
The partnership marks WeRide and Uber’s entry into Spain and represents the fourth city covered by their strategic partnership, which targets 15 cities globally by 2030.

title: Uber, WeRide secure Spain’s first Level 4 autonomous driving permit
